name: gemini-subagent
description: Managed Gemini CLI and Antigravity workers for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Run controlled Google CLI workers from Codex
interface.longDescription: Delegate work to official Gemini or Antigravity CLIs while Codex controls accounts, quota checks, concurrency, status, cancellation, native session continuation, durable results, and verification.
defaultPrompt: Show Gemini worker, quota, account, or session status with $gemini-subagent:status
Retrieve the latest managed Gemini result with $gemini-subagent:result
